quotes: a few notes i want to mention because i couldn't add them to the video. 1: don't try to max out speed. his a2 major trace gives extra elation damage when exceeding 140 spd, up to a max of 200 spd. you shouldn't be trying to have all your substat rolls land on spd. the reason is that the extra damage you get from the speed isn't worth losing crit dmg/rate. that's why i said to get at least 160-ish and get the rest of the speed from allies like robin summertto or asta. 2: his elation could also be a follow-up. this is just a reminder that the a4 major trace can turn the elation skill into a follow-up if no one apart from aventurine waveflair himself does. that means he can be used in teams with follow-ups too. 3: be mindful of skill points i forgot to add this as a team, but aventurine waveflair likes to eat sp like it's a 5-course meal. you should try to be mindful of when you will need to basic attack or use a skill. of course, you can make it easier by using characters who don't need as much sp, like tribbie or robin summertto. you could also make it much easier by using sparkle.

a few notes i want to mention because i couldn't add them to the video. 1: don't try to max out speed. his a2 major trace gives extra elation damage when exceeding 140 spd, up to a max of 200 spd. you shouldn't be trying to have all your substat rolls land on spd. the reason is that the extra damage you get from the speed isn't worth losing crit dmg/rate. that's why i said to get at least 160-ish and get the rest of the speed from allies like robin summertto or asta. 2: his elation could also be a follow-up. this is just a reminder that the a4 major trace can turn the elation skill into a follow-up if no one apart from aventurine waveflair himself does. that means he can be used in teams with follow-ups too. 3: be mindful of skill points i forgot to add this as a team, but aventurine waveflair likes to eat sp like it's a 5-course meal. you should try to be mindful of when you will need to basic attack or use a skill. of course, you can make it easier by using characters who don't need as much sp, like tribbie or robin summertto. you could also make it much easier by using sparkle.
